story.title: The Adventures of the Blues
paragraphs_en: Click! Click! Clank! Clank! Bonnie Blue heard some strange noises. She realized they were coming from her father's laboratory. Bonnie went to check and found that he was working on a cap that could help him fly.
Baba Blue had completed his experiment and went on a splendid trial flight.
Bonnie Blue happily waved him good bye and went inside.
But soon Bonnie started missing him terribly. She became gloomy and bored. She had no one to play with.
Suddenly Bonnie had an idea and decided to create Bombastic Boots.
She studied all night and finally created her Bombastic Boots. Now she could jump as high as a rabbit and reach her dad.
She wore the boots and a superhero cape and shot into the sky.
She went into the sky so rapidly that even the birds got terrified of her. Brave Bonnie Blue was as daring as a superhero.
Boeing! and she shot right into the space.
Oh no! Bonnie was about to crash. But, fortunately her father spotted her at right time, grasped her and saved her.
Baba Blue checked out the Bombastic Boots. He found them to be very impressive and made several of them.
Finally, they all went into the space along with their pet cat Martin. They traveled to all the planets and galaxies and enjoyed scaring aliens. What a fun life they had! Thanks to Bonnie Blue..
